why_this_slot.text: Best modeled placement for Victor Mesa Jr. is slot #6 (4.458 expected team runs/game).
Slots #6, #7, #5, #3, #4, #8, #9, #2, #1 are within 0.01 runs/game of each other — essentially equivalent under the model’s operational band.
Offensive profile group: Three True Outcomes (exploratory unsupervised cluster — not a definitive archetype).
Cleanup (#4) models +0.001 R/G vs his average placement — typically less value than mid/lower-order spots when power/run-production profiles are modest relative to the nine.
